dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: It's a lot different from what I'm used to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there something you don't like?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no! That's not what I meant at all!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Being here... It's just a new sensation, that's all!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I've never been somewhere so amazing! I'm so excited, my heart feels like it's beating a mile a minute!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess this place is pretty big...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Definitely... The size is only part of it, though. What's really impressive is what you've done with the place!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I never get lost in the mountains back home, and that's a big area, too.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: But, as I was exploring this place just now, I really had to pay attention, or I never would have found my way back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay. I would come and save you!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Then, if you hear the frantic ringing of a silver bell, come find me, okay?
